As a youth, I had hoped to settle problems for those who came after; now I am quietly content if I do little more than state them. For even that, I now think, is much; it is at least the half of knowledge. In this particular field the evil of ignorance is magnified by our efforts to suppress that which never can be suppressed, though in the effort of suppression it may become perverted.

arxiv-1711-02379.title: ON THE GENERATION OF PYTHAGOREAN TRIPLES AND REPREZENTATION OF INTEGERS AS A DIFFERENCE OF TWO SQUARES Journal: Arxiv
arxiv-1711-02379.creator: Emil Asmaryan
arxiv-1711-02379.description: Abstract The general formulas for finding the quantity of all primitive and nonprimitive triples generated by the given number x x have been proposed. Also the formulas for finding the complete quantity of the representations of the integers as a difference of two squares have been obtained. 1 Introduction The equation x^{2}+y^{2}=z^{2} (1) is under consideration.

arxiv-1810-09084.title: A general learning system based on neuron bursting and tonic firing
arxiv-1810-09084.creator: Tim Lui
arxiv-1810-09084.description: Abstract This paper proposes a theoretical framework for the biological learning mechanism as a general learning system. The proposal is as follows. The bursting and tonic modes of firing patterns found in many neuron types in the brain correspond to two separate modes of information processing, with one mode resulting in awareness, and another mode being subliminal.

arxiv-2006-08739.title: Generalized Outer Bounds on the Finite Geometric Sum of Ellipsoids
arxiv-2006-08739.creator: Navid Hashemi, Justin Ruths
arxiv-2006-08739.description: Abstract General results on convex bodies are reviewed and used to derive an exact closed-form parametric formula for the boundary of the geometric (Minkowski) sum of k k ellipsoids in n n -dimensional Euclidean space. Previously this was done through iterative algorithms in which each new ellipsoid was added to an ellipsoid approximation of the sum of the previous ellipsoids.

arxiv-2201-08723.title: Statistical Inference on Explained Variation in High-dimensional Linear Model with Dense Effects
arxiv-2201-08723.creator: Hua Yun Chen
arxiv-2201-08723.description: Abstract Statistical inference on the explained variation of an outcome by a set of covariates is of particular interest in practice. When the covariates are of moderate to high-dimension and the effects are not sparse, several approaches have been proposed for estimation and inference.

arxiv-2304-04626.title: On the state-space model of unawareness
arxiv-2304-04626.creator: Alex A.T. Rathke
arxiv-2304-04626.description: Abstract We show that the knowledge of an agent carrying non-trivial unawareness violates the standard property of ’necessitation’, therefore necessitation cannot be used to refute the standard state-space model. A revised version of necessitation preserves non-trivial unawareness and solves the classical Dekel-Lipman-Rustichini result.

arxiv-2410-05593.title: When Graph Neural Networks Meet Dynamic Mode Decomposition
arxiv-2410-05593.creator: Dai Shi, Lequan Lin *, Andi Han, Zhiyong Wang, Yi Guo, Junbin Gao
arxiv-2410-05593.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Dai Shi, Lequan Lin *, Andi Han, Zhiyong Wang, Yi Guo, Junbin Gao. Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have emerged as fundamental tools for a wide range of prediction tasks on graph-structured data. Recent studies have drawn analogies between GNN feature propagation and diffusion processes, which can be interpreted as dynamical systems. In this paper, we delve deeper into this perspective by connecting the dynamics in GNNs to modern Koopman theory and its numerical method, Dynamic Mode Decomposition (DMD).

arxiv-2507-10749.title: RCG: Safety-Critical Scenario Generation for Robust Autonomous Driving via Real-World Crash Grounding
arxiv-2507-10749.creator: Benjamin Stoler, Juliet Yang, Jonathan Francis, Jean Oh
arxiv-2507-10749.description: Abstract Safety-critical scenarios are essential for training and evaluating autonomous driving (AD) systems, yet remain extremely rare in real-world driving datasets. To address this, we propose Real-world Crash Grounding (RCG), a scenario generation framework that integrates crash-informed semantics into adversarial perturbation pipelines.

britannica-1911-zouave.description: Article 'Zouave' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 28), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. ZOUAVE, the name given to certain infantry regiments in the French army. The corps was first raised in Algeria in 1831 with one and later two battalions, and recruited solely from the Zouaves, a tribe of Berbers, dwelling in the mountains of the Jurjura range (see Kabyles). In 1838 a third battalion was raised, and the regiment thus formed was commanded by Lamoricière.

By applying microarray on 397 human oocytes and embryos at six developmental stages, we studied the transcription dynamic

pmc-10757071.title: The significance of long non-coding RNAs in the pathogenesis, diagnosis and treatment of inflammatory bowel disease
pmc-10757071.creator: Fei Jiang, Min Wu, Rongpeng Li
pmc-10757071.description: Inflammatory bowel diseases (IBD) are a group of chronic relapsing gastrointestinal inflammatory diseases with significant global incidence. Although the pathomechanism of IBD has been extensively investigated, several aspects of its pathogenesis remain unclear. Long non-coding RNAs (lncRNAs) are transcripts with more than 200 nucleotides in length that have potential protein-coding functions.

pmc-11498085.title: Genomics and synthetic community experiments uncover the key metabolic roles of acetic acid bacteria in sourdough starter microbiomes
pmc-11498085.creator: H. B. Rappaport, Nimshika P. J. Senewiratne, Sarah K. Lucas, Benjamin E. Wolfe, Angela M. Oliverio
pmc-11498085.description: While research on the sourdough microbiome has primarily focused on lactic acid bacteria (LAB) and yeast, recent studies have found that acetic acid bacteria (AAB) are also common members. However, the ecology, genomic diversity, and functional contributions of AAB in sourdough remain unknown.

pmc-11643388.title: Influence of Alkaline Reduced Water Supplementation on Glucose and Lipid Metabolism in Non-Diabetic and Diabetic Rats
pmc-11643388.creator: Chung-Hsiung Huang, Ying-Chiun Chao, Meng-Tsan Chiang, Josep Julve, Clive J Petry, Joana Rossell
pmc-11643388.description: Background: With the global increase in metabolic disorders, identifying effective dietary strategies is crucial for enhancing health outcomes. While various health advantages of alkaline reduced water (ARW) have been documented, its specific impacts on glucose and lipid metabolism in both healthy and diabetic conditions are still not well understood.

pmc-11656926.title: Integrating genetic and clinical data to predict lung cancer in patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease
pmc-11656926.creator: Zhan Gu, Yonghui Wu, Fengzhi Yu, Jijia Sun, Lixin Wang
pmc-11656926.description: BackgroundChronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) is closely linked to lung cancer (LC) development. The aim of this study is to identify the genetic and clinical risk factors for LC risk in COPD, according to which the prediction model for LC in COPD was constructed.

pmc-12437889.title: The Phenomenology of Bereavement: Sensory Experiences of the Deceased
pmc-12437889.creator: A F Silva, A C Rodrigues, A C Matias-Martins, F Santos, P Coelho, R M Lopes, T Vieira, V Melo
pmc-12437889.description: IntroductionMany grieving individuals report sensory and phenomenological experiences involving deceased loved ones, such as visual, auditory, or sensed presences. These experiences are common across cultures, with 40-70% of bereaved spouses reporting them. They can provide comfort or cause distress, and can last from brief moments to several years.

pmc-12442742.title: Pocket Infection Leading to Complete Extrusion of an Implantable Cardiac Defibrillator
pmc-12442742.creator: Wassim Beladel, Soukaina Aabbar, Karim Hasni, Mohamed El Minaoui
pmc-12442742.description: Pocket infection and complete device extrusion are uncommon but potentially life-threatening complications that present significant management challenges. Extrusion results from progressive skin erosion until the device exits the subcutaneous pocket, at which point the risk of bacterial contamination becomes high.

pmc-12447464.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundThe interruption of tuberculosis care and monitoring activities during the Covid-19 pandemic resulted in delays in diagnosis and treatment of this disease, which compromised progress towards the goal of elimination.ObjectivesAnalyze tuberculosis-related activities offered in primary health care settings in Brazil during 2020–2022MethodsThis mixed-method convergent parallel study was conducted in four state capitals, with the number of health units defined by sample calculation.

pmc-12716562.title: Efficacy of intravenous thrombolysis in treating cortical and lacunar strokes: analysis from the Qatar Stroke Registry in a multi-ethnic population
pmc-12716562.creator: Kim H Tran, Naveed Akhtar, Sujatha Joseph, Deborah Morgan, Blessy Babu, Ryan Uy, Ashfaq Shuaib
pmc-12716562.description: ObjectiveIntravenous thrombolysis is an effective method in treating acute ischaemic stroke, with several studies reporting improved outcomes and reduced mortality rates. However, there are limited data on whether thrombolysis is effective in treating different ischaemic stroke subtypes in the Middle East and North African region.

pmc-12954009.title: My Heart and CKD: Pathway to Implementing a Decision Aid for Patients With CKD and Coronary Artery Disease
pmc-12954009.creator: Julie N. Babione, Pantea Javaheri, Denise Kruger, Todd Wilson, Winnie Pearson, Maureena Loth, Violet March, Wayne Gerber, Bryan J. Har, Michelle M. Graham, Stephen B. Wilton, Krystina B. Lewis, Matthew T. James
pmc-12954009.description: Background:Patients with chronic kidney disease (CKD) at times must decide whether to take an invasive approach to management of coronary artery disease (CAD), which involves procedures such as angiography, angioplasty, and surgery, versus attempt management with medications alone. My Heart and CKD is a decision aid to support shared decision-making (SDM) between patients and their care providers in these situations.

pmc-13341761.title: Sequential translation-based multimodal sentiment analysis under uncertain missing modalities
pmc-13341761.creator: Yan Hai, Shanqi Lu, Zhizhong Liu, Ling Shang, Hongxiang Sun, Jing Wang
pmc-13341761.description: Multimodal Sentiment Analysis (MSA) aims to fuse information from multiple modalities to achieve precise sentiment classification. Recently, the issue of uncertain missing modalities has become one of the new challenges in MSA. Previous studies have attempted to solve this issue by building information interactions on modality pairs consisting of two modalities.

pmc-13376208.title: Synthesis and anti-antileishmanial profile of novel thiazolidine-4-one derivatives and molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulations studies
pmc-13376208.creator: Soheila Molaei, Jafar Abbasi Shiran, Arina Esmailzadeh, Soroush Rajabi, Mohammad Reza Rahimi, Yasamin Abedini Zal, Saghi Sepehri
pmc-13376208.description: Leishmaniasis is a severely neglected intracellular protozoan disease caused by infection with parasites of the Leishmania genus, affecting over 98 countries globally. Presently, the infection threatens the health of more than 350 million people globally, resulting in an estimated 60,000 deaths yearly from both visceral and cutaneous forms of the parasite.
